Legato 0.10.0 keeps its own windows out of what you capture: the island, your dictated words, the bubble and the Notes side panel stay on your screen but don't show in screenshots, recordings or a screen you share in a call.

## The bar and the island

- Hidden from screen capture (Snipping Tool, recorders, Meet, Teams and Zoom screen sharing, remote desktops), with a switch in Settings › Legato bar. It replaces the meeting card's own switch.
- The Notes pill steps aside with the resting island for a fullscreen window, so it no longer sits over a remote desktop's toolbar during a meeting.
- TightVNC in full screen is recognised, while Windows' sign-in prompt and the Snipping Tool's overlay no longer hide the island.

## Dictation

- "Press enter" is caught before AI cleanup or a transform can reword or drop it.

## Fixes

- Quitting ends Legato within five seconds, even when something holds it up.
- Logs keep the last five files instead of one, so a problem from earlier in the day can still be traced.

## Install

Download `Legato_0.10.0_x64-setup.exe` (or `arm64`), or the `.msi` to work in apps run as administrator. Installed copies update themselves. The installers aren't code-signed yet; see [Verify a download](https://github.com/Abhash-Chakraborty/legato/blob/main/docs/verify.md).
